figures.source_title: Constellation Software Inc. and Lumine Group Inc. Complete Purchase of WideOrbit Inc. and Lumine Group Spin-Out - Lumine

facts.text: Trapeze Group, acquired by Constellation Software in July 1995, became Constellation's first acquisition. In 2011, Trapeze Group and related companies were reorganized under the name Volaris Group to reflect their expansion beyond public transit into other vertical markets.
facts.source_title: 30 Years of Reaching Higher with Volaris Group

facts.text: Lumine Group, Volaris' communications and media portfolio, completed its spin-out from Constellation Software in February 2023 to become a separate publicly traded company. The spin-out coincided with Lumine's acquisition of WideOrbit, which serves as the system of record for more than 5,000 stations and cable networks worldwide.
facts.source_title: Constellation Software Inc. and Lumine Group Inc. Complete Purchase of WideOrbit Inc. and Lumine Group Spin-Out - Lumine

facts.text: Volaris Group launched Vencora in November 2022 as a new global division dedicated to acquiring and growing software and technology-enabled businesses serving the banking, insurance, and financial services industries.

Omegro was formally introduced on June 25, 2024, as a global organization bringing together Volaris businesses supporting customers across all aspects of the supply chain and supporting ecosystem, offering warehousing & inventory control, ERP & CRM, fleet & logistics management, and asset maintenance software applications.
facts.source_title: Introducing Omegro: A Global Collective of Technology Businesses Offering a Permanent and Safe Home to Provide Long-Term Sustainable Growth for the World's Most Impactful Software Companies

facts.text: Michael (Mike) Dufton was appointed Volaris Group CEO effective January 2024. Dufton had been Managing Director of the Dufton Portfolio inside Volaris Group and continues as CEO of Vencora.

facts.item: Mark Miller promoted to Constellation President
facts.text: Mark Miller transitioned from Volaris Group CEO to Executive Chairman of Volaris Group and was appointed President of Constellation Software in late 2025. Miller co-founded Trapeze Group in 1988 and has worked with Constellation, Volaris and its subsidiaries for more than 30 years.
facts.source_title: Constellation Software Inc. Announces Appointment of Mark Miller to its Board of Directors

facts.text: Volaris Group has never sold a business since its inception. The company's philosophy of being 'Forever Invested' emphasizes long-term commitment to helping acquired companies achieve sustainability through autonomy, best practice sharing, and access to a global ecosystem of businesses.

In 2023, Volaris Group's portfolio of standalone software companies officially passed the 200 mark. The company completed its largest transactions to date in 2023 and expanded into new vertical markets through acquisitions from 13 countries.

Volaris Group established an AI Center of Excellence in late 2024 comprised of AI champions led by VP of Integration and Strategy Jeff Chow. The center provides guidance to businesses exploring AI use cases and has developed structured learning programs including developer training, hackathons, and functional working groups.
facts.source_title: AI Disruption is Reshaping Software | Volaris Group

facts.text: Volaris Group is introducing the AI Accelerator in 2026, a program designed to rapidly help businesses upskill their teams and adapt their product visions for the new realities of AI adoption.
facts.source_title: Volaris Developer Program: Moving Businesses Toward AI Enablement

facts.text: Volaris Group grows its companies through sharing best practices accumulated from hundreds of acquisitions and through organic initiatives in product development. Business units retain autonomy while benefiting from support provided by a dedicated Strategy Team and access to benchmarks and best practices across the global network.
facts.source_title: Volaris Strategy Team: Empowering Growth Through Supported Autonomy

facts.text: In 2025, Volaris Group marked its first acquisition in Japan with HeartCore and expanded its presence in Australia, Hong Kong, New Zealand, and Singapore, broadening its Asia-Pacific footprint.
facts.source_title: Volaris Group's 2025 M&A Year in Review
